money.awaiting_payment.buyer: Nothing has been charged yet. Pay by {due} to keep this order.
money.awaiting_payment.seller: Waiting for the buyer to pay by {due}. Do not hand over the item yet.
money.cancelled_unpaid.buyer: This order was cancelled before payment. Nothing was charged.
money.cancelled_unpaid.seller: This order was cancelled before payment. There is nothing to hand over.
money.held_before_delivery.buyer: Your payment of {amount} is held by TrustBazaar. The seller must hand the item over by {due}, or you get a full refund.
money.held_before_delivery.seller: The buyer's payment is held by TrustBazaar. Hand the item over by {due} to be paid. If you miss it, the buyer is refunded.
money.held_after_delivery.buyer: Your payment is held by TrustBazaar. The seller is paid when you confirm receipt, or automatically on {at} unless you open a dispute.
money.held_after_delivery.seller: The item was delivered. You are paid when the buyer confirms receipt, or automatically on {at} if no dispute is opened.
money.held_protection.buyer: Your payment is held until the protection period ends on {at}. If the seller takes the account back before then, open a dispute.
money.held_protection.seller: You are paid on {at}, when the protection period ends, unless the buyer opens a dispute.
money.frozen.buyer: Your payment of {amount} is frozen while TrustBazaar reviews your dispute. Nobody is paid until it is decided.
money.frozen.seller: The payment of {amount} is frozen while TrustBazaar reviews the buyer's dispute. You are paid only if it is decided in your favour.
money.released.buyer: Your payment of {amount} was released to the seller on {at}.
money.released.seller: The payment of {amount} was released to you on {at}. See Payouts for the transfer.
money.refunded.seller: The buyer was refunded {amount} on {at}. You receive nothing for this order.
money.partially_refunded.buyer: You were refunded {amount} on {at}. The rest was paid to the seller.
money.partially_refunded.seller: The buyer was refunded {amount} on {at}. You were paid the rest.
confirm.confirm_receipt: Releasing payment pays the seller {amount} now and ends your right to dispute this order.
confirm.release_early: Releasing early pays the seller {amount} now. You can no longer dispute if the seller takes the account back, even before {at}.
confirm.open_dispute: Opening a dispute freezes the payment until TrustBazaar decides. You can withdraw it before the decision, but not open the same kind of dispute again.
confirm.withdraw_dispute: Withdrawing ends this dispute for good. The seller is then paid automatically on {at} unless you open a different kind of dispute.
confirm.seller_cancel: Cancelling refunds the buyer {amount} in full and gives you a seller strike. Three strikes in 90 days suspend your selling.
confirm.place_bid: A bid of {amount} is binding. If you win, you must pay within the payment window or receive a strike.
confirm.proxy_bid: TrustBazaar will bid for you up to {amount}, only as much as needed to keep you in the lead. Every bid it places is binding.
confirm.buy_now: You will pay {amount} in total: item {item} and delivery {delivery}. The money is held until the item is delivered.
confirm.share_handover_code: Give this code to the seller only after you have checked the item. Entering it counts as delivery.
sim.payment: Test mode: no real money is moved. Payments are simulated.
sim.courier: Test mode: this shipment is simulated. No courier will collect it.
error.network: We could not reach TrustBazaar. Check your connection and try again.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
error.session_ended: You have been signed out. Sign in again to continue.
error.step_up: For your security, enter the code we sent to your phone to continue.
error.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
error.not_found: This page or item no longer exists.
error.conflict: This changed while you were looking at it. The page has been refreshed.
error.generic: Something went wrong on our side. If you contact us, quote reference {ref}.
